0022600021.text: Dallas hosts Houston in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, with the Mavericks (3-2, 4th in the Southwest and 7th in the West, 2 games back) on a two-game winning streak and 2-1 on the road, 1-1 at home. Houston arrives 5-0, first in both the Southwest and the West, on a five-game winning streak. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Naji Marshall is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. Houston is missing Marcus Smart (forearm strain), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Alperen Sengun is day-to-day with back soreness and a game-time decision. Houston won the last meeting 128-110 in Houston on October 21, so the Mavericks trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series, though the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26.
